//: Pack descriptor (PAR-4). Everything the shared governance harness needs to know about THIS pack.
//why: The portfolio gate and the lineage proof were benefits-only scripts with pack facts baked in, so a second pack could not be gated without forking the harness - and forking the harness is how four copies of the log readers drifted three fixes apart. Every pack-specific fact the gate needs lives here; the harness itself carries none.
//derived: Every value below was read out of THIS repo, not copied from the benefits descriptor: prefix from cdk/app.py, tenants from cdk/ (sp-a/sp-b, 7 occurrences each), stacks from app.py under the gate's own context, runtime name from agents/pharmacovigilance/manifest.yaml, tool names from the @telemetry.instrument decorators (the identity that actually appears in the aegis.call line), signoff state from cdk/pv_stacks/workflow_stack.py.
//stacks: network is deliberately absent: it is provisioned only under -c network_mode=private, and the gate's context does not set it. lineage is present because the gate always passes -c capture_all=1.

runtime.name: pv_runtime_agent
runtime.//: matched as a substring against ECR repositories when reporting toolkit residue

lineage.//lambda_stems: The governed tool Lambdas this pack deploys, as the stem after the <prefix>- in the function name. Declared because the lineage proof drops any CloudTrail invoke it cannot map to a tool identity (`if t:`), SILENTLY - so a governed Lambda whose name has no lexical overlap with the tool it hosts is simply absent from the parity check, and 'zero orphans' quietly means 'zero orphans among the ones that mapped'. tests/test_lineage_tool_mapping.py asserts every stem here resolves. Found 2026-09-08 while preparing REL-5 (L41).
lineage.//tool_names: These are @telemetry.instrument names, NOT the MCP tool names in manifest.yaml. The two differ for the core Lambda: the manifest exposes draft_narrative / finalize_submission / commit_causality on the pv-core target, but all three run inside one function that logs a single aegis.call line under 'pv_core'. The lineage proof compares CloudTrail Lambda invokes against aegis.call lines, so the instrument name is the one that has to be declared here.

tool_aliases.//: the core-tools Lambda stem shares no lexical overlap with the pv_core tool it hosts, so it needs an explicit alias - the same shape as benefits' coretools -> benefits_core

workflow.//: the state a driven case must reach for LIN_case_driven to pass
